what: Session tracking cleanup centralized in scripts/hooks/clear-tracking.sh — shared function clear_session_tracking(cache_dir, sid) used by PreCompact and SessionStart. Adding new tracking file types only requires updating this one file. track-remember.sh is separate (only clears correction-pending flag, not full cleanup).
why: Cleanup logic was duplicated across 2 scripts with hardcoded file names. Centralized to prevent bugs when adding new tracking file types.
